title: Phenomenal
text: Magnificent guide, María, friendly, entertaining and knows Seville very well, her advice for other visits is great.

title: Amazing & knowledgeable tour guide
text: Maria is amazing! She contacted me ahead of time to coordinate all of the details. She was punctual, professional and incredibly knowledgeable. She also gave us many recommendations for things to do and see after we finished with her tour. I very much recommend this tour!
author: Marsha_S

title: Our guide did an excellent job! It...
text:
Our guide did an excellent job! It was a group tour but we were the only ones there so it was like a private tour.
We went past the 3 hours and our guide was informative and friendly. We enjoyed it.
author: Kent C

title: The highlights here are of course...
text: The highlights here are of course the Alcazar and the Cathedral and we spent just barely enough time in each, as so much to experience. The guide was efficient, helpful, and instructive and knew what she wanted us to see and why -- the very best kind of guide. Much of what you will want to see in the Alcazar and in the Cathedral is actually somewhat far from you way up in the ceilings or behind tall railings, so bring binoculars and improve your stay.
author: Gregory M

title: Maria was excellent, she covered a...
text: Maria was excellent, she covered a lot of ground in the three hours and it was great to skip the line at Alcazar.
author: David F

title: We met Maria promptly at our...
text: We met Maria promptly at our assigned meeting place behind the Cathedral. To our surprise, our group tour turned into a private tour as just my husband and I were the group. Because of other plans we had made, Maria altered the standard tour slightly so we went to the Alcazar, Cathedral, another wonderful church and then to the Roman Ruins and Mushroom ... the addition of the ruins and the mushroom allowed us to walk through the shopping streets and see other parts of the city that we may have missed, but loved seeing them. Maria also told us to save our Alcazar tickets to return another
author: Jane_R

title: Our guide was Maria who was an...
text: Our guide was Maria who was an absolute delight, enthusiastic, passionate and rightly proud of her adopted city. The tour begins outside the cathedral and rightly focuses on that outstanding building as well as the Jewish Quarter and the Royal Palace. We were lucky in that it was just Maria plus the two of us, so no trawling around in large groups which helps a lot. She is extremely knowledgeable and interesting, you don't just get a regurgitated list of dates and facts but a more rounded and informative view of all of the architecture and artefacts. title: A phenomenal Alcazar tour with Maria
text: Wonderful tour of Alcazar, full of stories and images.  Maria was super engaged and excited throughout the tour. Passion demonstrated her love of her work.
